authority: external review of the draft paper (A3: factor of two; D1: leave-one-rung-out)

design.a_axis_provenance: external review of the draft (worst cell, quoted 0.152 eV); not verifiable in-repo

pair_level_redefinition: A_pair = max_{i,j} |delta (e_i - e_j)| <= 2 A_axis; under |d0| >= A_pair the rule keeps its shape and the factor of two is absorbed into the number.
proposition: delta d = delta e_i - delta e_j  =>  |delta d| <= |delta e_i| + |delta e_j| <= 2 A_axis  (triangle inequality); the strict sufficient rule is |d0| >= 2 A_axis.

registered_criteria.refutation: zero leakage in every trial would mean the factor of two is not needed
registered_criteria.statement: at m=1 the bounded (Uniform) arm shows a strictly positive leak rate

registered_criteria.refutation: any leaking pair at m=2 refutes the strict criterion in the bounded arm
registered_criteria.statement: at m=2 the bounded arm leaks in no trial and no pair

registered_criteria.refutation: a ratio well below 1 would make 2A merely conservative
registered_criteria.statement: max |delta d| / (2A) reaches ~1, so 2A is attained rather than padding

registered_criteria.refutation: if 2*A_hat misses flips, the prospective claim fails
registered_criteria.statement: leave-one-rung-out at 2*A_hat declares no flipped pair safe; at A_hat it does

registered_criteria.refutation: not a refutation target: recorded either way as a boundary of the theorem
registered_criteria.statement: the unconditional guarantee needs bounded single-cell effects; the Normal arm need not be leak-free at m=2

two_sentence_rule: the THEOREM (analytic 2A bound) and the SIMULATION (empirical zero leak) are reported as two separate sentences; the simulation may never be used to prove the theorem
